feeds.name: Google Suggest — CZ pain completions
feeds.yields: Czech-language autocomplete completions for pain-shaped query patterns; the completion string is the evidence.

access.basis: Undocumented public autocomplete endpoint, no published terms. Ban risk is the constraint, not freshness: the cadence is capped at 1 run/day and the cap IS the mitigation. 144 queries/run = 24 seeds x 6 patterns, counted from the SEEDS and PATTERNS lists in scripts/fetch_suggest.sh. The endpoint also requires ie=utf-8&oe=utf-8 or the body comes back non-UTF-8.

expected_yield.basis: MEASURED CEILING: the script issues exactly 144 queries per run (24 seeds x 6 patterns, counted from the SEEDS and PATTERNS lists in scripts/fetch_suggest.sh) and writes one line per query that returned completions, so 144 is a hard maximum, not an estimate. The floor is an author estimate. ZERO records have ever reached the ledger.

feeds.name: NKÚ — audit conclusions bulletin
feeds.yields: Supreme Audit Office audit conclusions: named state failures with quantified waste and the body responsible.
feeds.blocker: Fetcher now exists (scripts/fetch_nku.sh); stays `planned` until it lands a record, because status is INTENT and PENDING/LIVE in feed_health.json is the observed half. www.nku.cz 403s generic clients; the non-www host works with lowercase filenames.

access.basis: Public bulletin of a state audit body; statutory publication, no auth.

expected_yield.basis: UNMEASURED — no fetcher exists, so no payload has been parsed and no field names are confirmed. required_fields is deliberately EMPTY rather than guessed. This is the LLM-fallback proof feed: its HTML is expected to resist structured parsing, so a parse violation here is the designed path to extraction: llm-fallback, not a defect. Roughly 2-6 conclusions per month accumulate on a per-year page.

feeds.name: MPSV/ÚP — volná místa (vacancies)
feeds.yields: Czech job vacancies from the Labour Office register, carrying employer IČO, CZ-ISCO occupation, salary floor and NUTS-3 region — the entity-graph join.
feeds.blocker: Fetcher is a separate parallel worker that may slip to Phase 3 without blocking CP2. The GDPR contact-field allowlist and its checker must land BEFORE any record can be written — the rule has to exist before the first record, not alongside it.

access.basis: The dataset licence explicitly disclaims both copyright and the sui-generis database right. Note the separate GDPR obligation: the DCAT record declares obsahuje-osobni-udaje (contact names, emails, phones), so an ALLOWLIST of safe fields is mandatory at ingest — licence permission is not privacy permission.

expected_yield.basis: Grounded in the probe's single measured day: 2026-08-19 carried 287 novy + 817 zmeneny + 986 zruseny = 2,090 items. THE CHANGELOG TRAP: the increment file is a changelog, not a list of new items — a parser ignoring typZmenyOpenData would record 2,090 new postings when 287 are new, a ~7x flood into an append-only permanent log. That is why typZmenyOpenData is a required field and why branching on change type is itself a contract check.
